prompt: During planning, someone floats an idea that is too vague for a real issue. How can it still join the sprint board?
explanation: Draft issues are project-native placeholder items: they sit on the board like any item, and convert into real issues when the idea firms up. No repository noise in the meantime.

options.text: Add it as a draft issue item in the Project
Open a placeholder issue and close it immediately
Put it in the wiki and hope
Tag the next release with it
